name: Teen Volunteers (Great Parks of Hamilton County)
what_you_do: Volunteer long term in parks. Jobs include habitat restoration, education programs and special events. You can work on golf course upkeep. You can grow native plants or garden. You can also care for animals. Role training and uniforms are provided.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17. Adults can volunteer too. Groups of 10 or more can volunteer together. Great Parks supports Eagle Scout, Gold Award and senior capstone projects.
duration: Long term volunteering. Time commitment is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Long term volunteer information sessions have ended for 2026. Great Parks says it will host them again in March 2027.
how_to_apply: Watch the Great Parks volunteer page for the March 2027 information sessions and use the Email Volunteer Engagement link on that page to ask about the teen steps. The page does not show a teen application link. Group projects use the Request a Project Match form.
notes: Confirm first: the page gives no teen application steps or time commitment. Great Parks also lists one day volunteer projects; the page read did not state a minimum age for them.
